title: React web app (Vite)
description: React single-page app on Vite with hot reload, component structure, a custom localStorage hook and a production build to dist/.
produces: Static production bundle in dist/ for any host (Vercel, Netlify, GitHub Pages)
run: npm run dev   then open the printed http://localhost:5173 URL
build: Build mode runs npm install and npm run build; the site is written to dist/
customize: src/App.jsx: the top-level layout and state
src/components/: add components here (ItemList.jsx is an example)
src/useLocalStorage.js: persisted state hook; replace with fetch() calls for a backend
